models_evaluated: causal forest with double machine learning

links.outcome: Subgroup calibration error of effect-tree treatment recommendations
links.effect: Four of five subgroups had calibration error < 0.08; one small subgroup (N=250) had calibration error 0.44, flagged as unreliable.
links.quote: Calibration analysis identified four of five subgroups as reliable for deployment (calibration error < 0.08), while one small subgroup (N=250) showed higher calibration error (0.44), illustrating how the framework rates unreliable heterogeneity.

unlisted_practices: Using causal forests and interpretable effect-trees with subgroup calibration to decide when personalized treatment rules are reliable enough for selective deployment

screen.reason: The study develops and empirically evaluates a deployment-readiness framework using subgroup calibration assessment to filter out unreliable predictions and enable selective deployment of treatment recommendations.

primary.practice: subgroup calibration assessment and selective deployment
